steps.instruction: In Grafana at http://127.0.0.1:3000/, create a NEW dashboard. Add a Stat visualization panel. Set the panel title to exactly '{{runid}} Availability'. For its query, select the 'TestData' data source (it may be called 'TestData' or 'TestData DB' — pick the TestData one) and leave the default scenario. Then save the dashboard with the title exactly '{{runid}} Bench Dashboard'. Confirm the save succeeded (no unsaved-changes indicator) and report the dashboard's URL/UID from the browser address bar.

Open a fresh page at http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/cfwcsdxqdjabkf/{{runid}}-bench-dashboard (hard reload, no cached edit state). Verify and report each of these from the rendered view-mode dashboard: (a) the dashboard title shown in the header, (b) the titles of all panels present, (c) the text content shown in the text panel, (d) the time range shown in the time picker, (e) the auto-refresh interval shown in the refresh selector, (f) open Dashboard Settings > General and report the dashboard tags listed. Also open the '{{runid}} Availability' panel's query editor (edit mode) and report which data source name is selected for its query. Do not change anything.
